Chapter 266: The Zerg'S Huge Harvest

The aliens detonated the light energy shield. Their operation surprised the observers from all forces in the local camp.

"They actually detonated the power of the gods! They not only wanted to destroy the space transmission channel, but also wanted to pit the Zerg!"

"Fortunately, the Zerg army responded in time and did not cause much damage!"

"Such an investment is also very costly for the aliens. After this battle, the Zerg has become the mortal enemy of the aliens!"

"In the future, these 108 districts will start to be lively!"

"The next confrontation between the Zerg and the aliens should come soon. It's really exciting!"

"We may be witnessing the birth of a great clan! It's a great honor!"

"..."

Many observers from all forces in the local camp have recognized the strength and heritage of the Zerg clan.

The explosion of the aliens completely cut off the retreat of the alien army on the battlefield. Their fight with the Zerg army was somewhat tragic.

The believers of the Lord of Light are somewhat different from the believers of the Spirit God. They seem to be much more rational and have not lost all their emotions and thoughts because of their firm belief.

This makes them look closer to normal intelligent creatures.

However, Wu Qing and the Queen of the Worm have tried to restore the normal rationality of the captured aliens and eliminate the influence of the Lord of Light, but they still cannot do it.

The Lord of Light's methods are more sophisticated. On the basis of allowing believers to retain more autonomy, he firmly controls everything about believers. Wu Qing is now powerless.

There is no way to rescue, so we can only physically destroy them!

The Zerg army continues to compress the space of the alien army's activities, divide and surround them in an orderly manner, and eat up the alien army, which is still very powerful in overall combat power.

Under the command of the Queen of the Worm, the Zerg Queen began to parasitically control the arms of certain value in the alien army.

The counterattack of these parasitic arms is like the last straw that crushes the alien army, breaking the invisible spirit of the alien army.

From this time on, the combat power of the alien army is much worse than before.

The Zerg army's attack was unstoppable, and they quickly wiped out the alien army.

The endless black tide buried the white spots one by one, and the entire battlefield gradually fell into darkness and calm.

Several terrifying auras rose in the darkness, as if they wanted to attack the Zerg army!

The well-prepared Queen Zerg instantly descended on the five-star Zerg hosts scattered above the battlefield, and a devastating aura descended on the Zerg army. Even the strong men in the main city felt it!

The unfathomable spiritual power of the Queen Zerg instantly suppressed the forces that wanted to take action.

Knowing that they were defeated, the forces in the dark retreated unwillingly.

The Queen Zerg did not take action, but let the people in the dark retreat.

The Queen Zerg's spiritual power slowly withdrew from the Zerg host, and the entire battlefield fell into darkness and calm again.

The war between the Zerg and the aliens, which exceeded everyone's expectations, came to an end here.

The Zerg successfully defeated the aliens and won this battle.

Each of the two tribes invested tens of millions of troops, and the victorious Zerg also lost nearly 20 million troops, including many high-star troops with strong combat power.

The troops invested by the alien race on the battlefield, except for the hundreds of thousands of troops that evacuated at the end, were all annihilated.

The scale of this battle was larger than the scale of the battle between the Naga and the Skeletons, and its impact was more far-reaching!

After the war, in addition to the resources obtained from the battlefield, the system suddenly obtained a huge amount of Qi resources!

This should be the luck that the Zerg plundered from the alien race by defeating the alien race!

This is a lot more than the Qi resources obtained from the entire war!

This is really a pleasant surprise, which gives the Zerg the confidence to act in a stronger posture after the war!

Wu Qing always thought that the Zerg had plundered the luck from the enemy in disguise by killing the enemy. Through this war, he found that the battle that the Zerg had fought before was not high enough to shake the luck of the forces behind the enemy.

As long as the luck of the forces behind the enemy is shaken, there will be a huge profit.

This battle can be regarded as shaking the luck of the alien race, thus plundering a large amount of luck of the alien race.

"It seems that we need to fight more big battles in the future!"

Wu Qing felt that small fights could no longer meet the needs of the Zerg's development.

"Haha, the Zerg won without any suspense!"

"A great tribe is about to rise! We are the witnesses!"

"The situation here is going to change drastically! Everyone needs to be prepared!"

"Now there is no need for the Bear, Wolf, and Eagle tribes to continue fighting!"

"These three tribes are not weak, but they are always unlucky. If they want to gain the status of a great tribe, they still have a long way to go!"

"I hope they won't be reckless and provoke the Zerg without knowing the depth of the situation!"

"They also have observers around, who should be able to see the situation clearly!"

"It's hard to say. The people sent to this battlefield by their tribes are young and energetic. This is a good thing in normal times, but now, there may be some trouble!"

"What are you afraid of? There are people above to suppress you!"

"Haha, I hope so!"

"..."

Observers from many forces have already recognized the status of the Zerg as a major clan, and now they are beginning to worry about the unity within the local camp.

…

The 66th city has become a ruin after such a great battle.

The ground is full of weapons and equipment and various combat supplies left by the alien human army. Fortunately, there are no corpses left, and there is not much smell of blood, which makes people feel much more comfortable.

The huge battlefield is like a garbage dump. If it is not cleaned up properly, it is difficult to walk normally.

After the Zerg army fought a great battle, the injured Zerg puppies burrowed into the ground on the spot to rest and recover.

The Zerg puppies in good condition quickly dispersed to the entire 66th city lord's protection area, found a suitable position, and burrowed into the ground to lurk.

The main combat forces of the Zerg army gradually retreated to the underground Zerg base and rested and recovered on the Zerg fungal carpet.

A large number of Zerg worker bees emerged from the ground and began to collect the spoils of victory and clean up the ruins of the battlefield.

All the alien human army controlled by the Zerg Queen also followed the Zerg main combat force and entered the underground Zerg base.

In the entire 66th city, the Zerg only had hard-working Zerg workers and Zerg hosts floating in the sky.

The elite Niu cavalry led by Niu Zhong could only camp on the spot and continue to stay on this battlefield.

The observers of various forces all sneaked into the dark, sorted out the information they obtained, and reported the situation to the forces behind them in various ways.

After tonight, the Zerg will be completely famous in the public battlefield of the southern theater. The reputation of the Zerg will spread to more places after fermentation.

…

The Zerg base underground in the 66th city has cleared a lot of Zerg workers to clean up the battlefield. The number of Zerg workers here has not decreased. A large number of Zerg workers are constantly digging resources to expand the space of the Zerg underground base.

The Zerg mother nest has never stopped hatching Zerg puppies, but the hatching speed has slowed down.

Wu Qing looked at the main combat arms of the Zerg that were in poor condition, and prepared to replenish the troops of these main combat arms first.

Start with the arms with the largest number of troops.

The Zerg Hydralisk originally had more than 400,000 troops, and a large number of them were added later. They suffered a lot of losses on the battlefield, and now the number of troops is less than 600,000.

Wu Qing used one-star Zerg Hydralisk to replenish, and the total number of Zerg Hydralisk was increased to one million.

The situation of Zerg cockroaches is similar to that of Zerg Hydralisk, but their defense and self-healing recovery capabilities are stronger, and the loss of personnel is less. Wu Qing increased their total number to 500,000.

All the replenishment is one-star troops, and the other arms behind are first replenished with one-star troops.

The combat power of the one-star Zerg troops is not much different from that of the two-star troops of ordinary races. They are the elite of the elite when they are taken to the battlefield.

The combat power of the Zerg army is sufficient for the time being, and it can be upgraded at any time when encountering a strong enemy.

The Zerg Dragons participated in the direct battle this time and suffered a lot of losses. Wu Qing increased their total number to 300,000.

Zerg Destroyers did not lose any personnel on the battlefield. The lowest two-star Zerg Destroyers already had 100,000, and Wu Qing increased their total number to 200,000.

Zerg Stealth Spiders performed very well in this war. Wu Qing added 50,000 one-star Zerg Stealth Spiders to the existing 50,000 three-star Zerg Stealth Spiders, increasing their total number to 100,000.

The number of one thousand Zerg Queens does not need to be increased for the time being. This type of troops that consumes a lot of resources but requires a small number can be replenished at any time.

Zerg Explosive Mosquitoes, Zerg Hosts, and Zerg Workers will be added at any time as needed.

Finally, there is the Zerg Puppy, a troop with no upper limit. Of course, the more the better. As long as there are enough energy resources, they can be hatched all the time. They are the real main combat force of the Zerg!

After Wu Qing's replenishment of troops, the main combat troops of the Zerg in the public battlefield of the Southern Theater exceeded two million, and the number of Zerg Puppies was countless.

Wu Qing's idea is to use the number of Zerg puppies to overwhelm the number of goblins of the alien race.

In the future, on this battlefield, the Zerg puppies will be the main fighting force. The more than two million Zerg main combat troops can be divided into several groups, or combined into one group, to assist the Zerg puppies in the offensive battle.

Otherwise, relying on the limited Zerg main combat troops to sweep the control area of the alien race, it is unknown when this battle will be fought.

Wu Qing has formulated a plan to replenish the forces of each Zerg army. The Zerg mother nest only took a short time to hatch enough Zerg main combat troops.

The rest of the time will be used to hatch Zerg puppies.
